capability: Learn sustained five-on-five combat from the intermediate states a frozen learner actually visits, including poor switches and depleted leads.
learned_authority: Learner selects every trajectory and reserved-evaluation action. A disclosed stat-damage teacher provides TRAIN branch continuation only; measured terminal returns train all three learned heads.
transfer_test: Eight new reserved TRAIN fights, with reordered moves, different starting HP and opponent level. No original failed regression replay and no consumed DEVELOPMENT reuse.
cheapest_falsifier: Branch truncation, fewer than 24 admitted contexts, retained-regret failure or no improvement over the frozen candidate in complete reserved fights.
time_box: Ninety minutes for one new-data collection and one fit; stop on invalid/truncated branches.
stop_condition: One fit after new collection, no optimizer sweep. Preserve failures and do not claim natural transfer or promote authority.
reason: The earlier 3-vs-2 terminal set had all-winning teacher branches and did not prevent destructive switching in five-member combat. New mixed-type five-on-five recipes provide basic reserve moves and learner-selected intermediate states.
source_origins: Four existing qualified TRAIN origins; retain original lineage identities.
